question: Do fresh musical attacks become more legible in lower Hybrid K1 (mode 32, board 0) during dense passages when a deposit-contrast multiplier gain = 1 - s*(1 - attack) is applied to newly deposited amplitude only, and which attack source earns inclusion?
step1_loss_location: Frozen as an observation before this file: on BOOM source 55.5-75 s the lower-Hybrid deposit amplitude (gain*level^1.5, level = fixed dB transfer of hop vu_level, ceiling -9 dBFS) is clamped at its maximum in 33.2% of frames (>=0.95 in 46.4%; room recording 15.5%/23.3%) while the raw bank and hop vu_level still carry the ~109 ms hits. The earliest supported loss is the deposit (composition), not the analysis bank. All non-baseline arms are consumer fixes at that operation and differ only in the attack source.

arms.0_baseline: detail off: exact accepted renderer path
arms.1_onset_fullbank_pregain: existing OnsetBeat (K1_ONSET_V2) over pre-gain linear_shape, its own transient_strength contract (0..1), computed on the host over the same accepted publication; no extra calibration
arms.2_fullbank_raw: diagnostic simplest arm: full-bank mean positive log change of the raw normalised bank (same tap/calibration as 3 and 4)
arms.3_static16: max over 16 static groups (5 channels each) of group mean positive log change, raw normalised tap
arms.4_adaptive16: same as 3 with the adaptive partition (455 splits/block, 100 ms descriptor smoothing, reconsider every 4 hops, 10% / two-update hysteresis, start static)

tap: raw normalised magnitudes rawSpectrum().bins[i].normalised_magnitude (before the 0.3/0.7 average, the board Mood LPF and AGC gain). Chosen from step-1 stage evidence (stage-explore.png): linear_shape smooths the dense 60-62 s hits that the raw bank resolves.

calibration_procedure.material: BOOM source replay 0-28 s only (development; outside the scored window), board-0 producer values per accepted non-quiet hop
calibration_procedure.rule: attack = clamp((x - p50) / (p95 - p50), 0, 1) with p50/p95 of that arm's raw strength on the material; constants written into the source before scoring
calibration_procedure.unread_generations: the renderer receives the max raw strength over generations it has not yet read (bounded ring of 8, cursor per board); a repeated read of the same publication carries attack 0 (no replay)

strength_note: pilot upper bound of the contract range [0, 0.25]; one value, chosen before results

inputs.dopex: excluded from tuning and from this comparison (held out; prior exposure in P6 replays recorded, so not called unseen)

reference_onsets: docs/evidence/P6/dbs/reference/boom-onsets.json and sonic-6-30-onsets.json produced by scripts/p6_dbs_reference_onsets.py with its own plant validation; song-time onsets only, no light data used

measure.signal: board-0 renderer deposit observation A_k = amplitude actually written by depositV9 at render frame k (10 ms), after the contrast multiplier; 0 when nothing is deposited
measure.birth: frame k with A_k >= 0.05, A_k >= A_{k-1}, A_k >= A_{k+1}, and prominence A_k / max(min(A_{k-3..k-1}), min(A_{k+1..k+3})) >= 1.20
measure.payload_check: for each birth, the final board-0 payload frame k+3 must show a local luma maximum within +-3 px of the deposit pixel advanced by the actual scroll steps; reported as a consistency rate, not gating
measure.matching: one-to-one greedy in time order; birth frame time t_b matches reference onset t_o when t_o - 0.005 <= t_b <= t_o + 0.045 s (50 ms span, below half the ~109 ms dense spacing); every reference onset in the scored window has an outcome
measure.false_birth: a birth in the scored window that matches no reference onset

missed_set: predeclared from the BASELINE run only, before any arm is scored: scored reference onsets in dense context that the baseline does not match AND whose cue is present in the raw bank (raw full-band positive log flux in the first accepted hop with capture time in [t_o, t_o + 0.030] >= 1.5 x the minimum over the preceding 60 ms of hops). Written to missed-set-<input>.json and hashed in STATUS before arms run.

criteria_per_input_boom_source_and_boom_.M1_recovery: matched(arm) covers >= 25% of the predeclared missed set and >= 10 events

transfer_sonic_room: winner keeps M2 >= 95% and M3 (no recovery requirement)
probes: scripts/p6_dbs_probes.py files: sustain (any birth beyond baseline is a false birth), weak_alone / weak_over_sustain / quiet_recovery (planted weak attacks matched >= baseline), spacing_200/100/75 (distinct births per train reported)
winner_rule: An arm is eligible only if it passes M1, M2 and M3 on BOTH boom_source and boom_room and the sonic transfer check and adds no probe false births.

Among eligible arms, prefer the simpler one unless the more complex arm recovers at least max(3 events, 10% relative) more of the missed set on BOTH BOOM inputs with M2/M3 no worse. Simplicity order: 1_onset (existing, own contract) = 2_fullbank_raw < 3_static16 < 4_adaptive16. Between 1 and 2 the one with more recovered events on both inputs wins; otherwise 1 (existing machinery).
If no arm is eligible: retain the baseline, report the demonstrated loss location, reject the intervention.

metric_validity_plants.uniform_dim: deposit multiplied by a constant 0.75 (quieter output alone): must recover 0 extra events and fail M1
metric_validity_plants.random_contrast: attack drawn from a seeded uniform random number each frame: must fail M3 (more false births) or M1
metric_validity_plants.oracle_contrast: attack = 1 for frames within 0..30 ms after a reference onset, else 0: must pass M1 (shows the measure can go green)

off_path_equivalence: detail off (and strength 0, and invalid/stale record) must reproduce the existing product frames.bin byte-for-byte for boom_source, boom_room, sonic_room
board_isolation: changing board-0 detail control leaves board-1 frames byte-identical
not_claimed: No perceptual or physical claim from these host results. Physical evidence is a separate requirement.
